rationale: Y independently reproduces two confirmed ground-truth bugs with exact line matches (the audio_tokenizer_v2.py:949 ceil/floor division bug, and the configuration docstring defaults mismatch), each with concrete anchored diffs. X finds almost none of the ground-truth-confirmed issues and actively asserts two of them are non-issues (claims slot-leak cleanup 'is handled' and vendored files 'carry a proper... header', both contradicting confirmed bugs/gaps from the real reviewers), which is a serious grounding failure even if not itself a 'finding'. Y has one likely false-positive (the put_req_chunk claim, plausibly rebutted by X's own more specific counter-investigation) and one unverified numeric claim, but its sheer volume of concrete, diff-anchored, correctly-grounded findings gives it materially better recall and actionability than X's shorter, more hedged, partly-wrong review.
